dungeons.name: Den of Nalorakk
dungeons.summary: Zandalari bear-loa den with icy footing mid-dungeon; widely rated one of the easier keys this season.

mustKick.why: Heals the pack; kick every one, purge if one slips.
Guides say stop every cast.
Kick every cast; spare kicks go on its Lightning Bolt.
Stop it near berry bushes so it can't grab the offering.
Random-target nuke; keep a kick rotation going.
Adds from Shattering Frostspike cast it during the boss; keep kicks rolling.

dangerousPacks: Birds before the first boss stack bleeds; the main trash threat per Icy Veins' tier list.
Territorial Matriarch gains Mother's Wrath per dead cub; tank needs soothes or a defensive.
Spirit of Hunger: kill the Starvation Effigy fast; Feast of Misery channel taxes healers.
Grizzled Warbringer (CC-immune): Primal Echo group damage plus Poison Spear Volley circles.
Loa Speaker Nanea: Earthquake hits two players who should step away; smash Volatile Totems immediately.

bosses.name: The Hoardmonger
bosses.summary: At 90/70/40% runs to a supply pile to empower one ability; take meat, then bone, then mushroom.
tank: Drag the boss toward the meat pile first, bone second, mushroom last.
healer: Expect Ravenous Bellow burst and a DoT once empowered.
Dispel Toxic Spores from mushroom soakers where possible.
dps: Help soak Rotten Mushrooms within 12 seconds so they don't burst.
everyone: Step out of slam impact zones.
Spread mushroom soaks across players to limit spore stacks.

bosses.name: Sentinel of Winter
bosses.summary: Slippery ice arena with tornadoes, add-spawning frost circles and soak snow piles.
tank: Park the boss beside an add's snow pile to negate Frozen Tempest pushback.
healer: Dispel Glacial Torment fast; prioritise undispellable players.
Prepare for Frozen Tempest ticking damage.
dps: Kill Frostspike adds while kicking Winter's Shroud.
everyone: Stack to bait Raging Squall tornadoes, then circle the room.
One player soaks each Rimeshatter from dead-add snow piles.

bosses.name: Nalorakk
bosses.summary: Bear loa leaves spectral Echoes; group must shield-block onslaughts and wall off charging Echoes.
tank: Never have your back toward an Echo during Overwhelming Onslaught.
After the knockback, run back to soak Forceful Slam.
healer: Onslaught brings three heavy hits; have cooldowns ready.
dps: Drop Echoing Maul echoes together, clear of allies.
everyone: Stand behind the shield during Overwhelming Onslaught.
Ring the center during Fury of the War God to block charging Echoes.

dungeons.name: Murder Row
dungeons.summary: Fel-tainted Silvermoon underworld crime den; straightforward but RP-heavy, with a staff clock-in event between bosses.

mustKick.why: Channel that charms a random player; kick or CC it.
Damaging channel; kick or CC, purge Fel Crazed.
Enrage; kick it or soothe it off.
Heals its demon; stop with spare kicks or CC.
Random-target damage; use spare kicks.
CC-immune, random-target nuke; spare kicks.
Kicking or CCing it despawns the reviewer during clock-in.

dangerousPacks: Defiled Golems after the third boss: heavy channelled Defiled Slam AoE; the dungeon's hardest stretch.
Massive Felwyrm: constant Over-Infused pulsing and big death AoE; tank grabs summoned Felwyrms.
Bribed Captain buffs nearby mobs with Deep Corruption; kill it first.
Shivan Punisher frenzies at 50%; burn it and dodge Whirlwind.
Corrupted Warlock: dispel or stack for Curse of Doom; a death summons a Doomguard.

bosses.name: Kystia Manaheart
bosses.summary: Shielded mage fought alongside her pet Nibbles; burn the pet while Felshield is up.
tank: Aim Nibbles' rotating Fel Spray away from the group.
healer: Dispel Corroding Spittle quickly.
Expect heavy group damage, worst when Chaos Barrage meets Mirror Images.
dps: Focus Nibbles during Felshield; save cooldowns for the damage amp.
Kick or CC the Mirror Images.
everyone: Step out of Fel Nova.

bosses.name: Zaen Bladesorrow
bosses.summary: Rogue boss using delivery barrels as cover and poison pressure on the tank.
tank: Defensive and poison dispel for Envenom.
healer: Prepare for Killing Spree AoE, worse with Fel-Infused Freight active.
dps: When Fire Bomb targets you, cleave the Fel-Infused Freight to clear its damage.
everyone: Hide behind your own barrel for Murder In A Row.
Avoid incoming Same-Day Delivery barrels.

bosses.name: Xathuux the Annihilator
bosses.summary: Fel axe brute; manage a thrown Legion Axe add and kite puddles during rage phases.
tank: Tank at the arena edge facing out for Legion Strike.
Kite slowly along the wall during Demonic Rage, using under half the room.
healer: Watch overlap of Infernal Crush and Demonic Rage.
dps: Swap to the Legion Axe quickly; its AoE ramps.
Hold cooldowns for the Demonic Rage damage amp.
everyone: Axe Toss target stands beside the boss so the axe lands in cleave.
Spread loosely for Infernal Crush.

bosses.name: Lithiel Cinderfury
bosses.summary: Warlock finale with an unkillable Infernal, imp spawns and gateway teleports past a Malefic Wave.
tank: Keep the boss away from the fixating Infernal; don't let it block gates.
Pick up the Vilefiend.
healer: Searing Fel Flame pulses constantly; plan throughput.
dps: Cleave adds before Malefic Wave reaches them.
Kick or CC Wild Imps' Felfire Burst.
everyone: Rotate kicks on Chaos Bolt.
After Malefic Wave passes, take the gateway on its safe side.

dungeons.name: Voidscar Arena
dungeons.summary: Voidstorm gladiator arena; pathing matters a lot, with safe and deadly hallways swapping after the first boss.

mustKick.why: Kick every cast.
Group-wide volley; kick every one.
Kick every cast.
AoE fear; always interrupt.
Channelled heal on another mob; kick or CC.
Random-target bolt; spare kicks, kill its Magma Totems.
Not kickable; kill its low-health target before it self-heals.
Not kickable; destroy orbs right as they spawn.

dangerousPacks: Before Taz'Rah the left hallway is the hard one; after the first boss the right is harder.
Brutal Overseer: break its shield during Brutal Slams or the AoE goes off.
Aegyra the Unyielding (CC-immune): leap into Earthsplitter, Champion's Spear tether, Savage Smash.
Devouring Brutalizers before Charonus: three must die; focus Devour targets and respect Dreadbellow pushes.
Agitated Voidscythe: Corrosive Essence on three players plus heavy tank hits.

bosses.name: Taz'Rah
bosses.summary: Void duelist whose shades dash through players, leaving rupture puddles that later fire orbs.
tank: Defensive for Void Blast; avoid being knocked into puddles.
healer: No specific healer callouts in sources beyond group damage from orbs.
dps: Same positioning as the group; keep puddles clumped.
everyone: Spread loosely near the edge for Nether Dash, shades kept together.
Rotate around the room to dodge Dark Bloom orbs.

bosses.name: Atroxus
bosses.summary: Poison beast that summons a tank-fixating creeper; stacking bites make his tank buster lethal.
tank: Kite the Toxic Creeper; each melee hit stacks Sickening Bite.
Respect Hulking Claw, especially with bite stacks.
healer: Heal through Poison Splash AoE.
dps: Swap to Toxic Creeper; it pulses AoE while alive.
everyone: Stay close to the boss to sidestep Noxious Breath.
Avoid poison puddles.

bosses.name: Charonus
bosses.summary: Void gravity boss; kite fixating orbs into singularities to clear both.
tank: Defensive for Dark Waves and face it away from the group.
healer: Singularities pulse AoE while they last; stay careful.
dps: Kite Gravitic Orbs through an Unstable Singularity to remove both.
everyone: Spread loosely for Cosmic Crash.
Void Cascade target runs from the boss; others clear its path.

dungeons.name: The Blinding Vale
dungeons.summary: Light-corrupted Harandar grove; hard first boss soaks, then a much gentler back half.

mustKick.why: Kick every one; spare kicks on Light Bolt.
At low health wakes Dormant Lashers; CC and burst it.
Kick every cast.
Random-target shot; spare kicks.
Random frontal channel; dodge or CC.

dangerousPacks: Lightgorged Lashers with Lightbloom Pollination must be focused until shields break.
Ruia area: Lightwarden's Blight mobs explode and leave puddles on death; plan pulls.
Overgrown Hydra (CC-immune) beams three random players; keep clear and use defensives.
Potatoad Matriarch ambush after Ruia: break Toadspawn eggs before they hatch.

bosses.name: Lightblossom Trinity
bosses.summary: Three-boss council; the whole group must soak Fertile Loam circles during Lightblossom Beam.
tank: Defensive for Bedrock Slam.
Keep bosses near a loam circle, off the Lightsower Dash line; reposition after scorched earth.
healer: Sources give no extra healer-specific notes.
dps: Kick Kezkitt's Light Bolt.
everyone: Tank plus two players soak the three circles during Lightblossom Beam.
Run out when Lekshi leaps to you; avoid Thornblade.

bosses.name: Ikuzz the Light Hunter
bosses.summary: Hunter boss seeding rooting thorns; roots become far deadlier after his 50% frenzy.
tank: Keep the boss where roots can be cleaved easily.
healer: Prepare for pulsing Thorncaller Roar damage.
dps: Cleave down roots on rooted allies.
everyone: Avoid Bloodthorn Roots; freedom effects clear them.
Bloodthirsty Gaze target runs, ideally over roots to break them.

bosses.name: Lightwarden Ruia
bosses.summary: Druid shifting from moonkin to bear to Haranir form, cycling all abilities in the last phase.
tank: Bear phase: self-heal or bleed-cleanse through Grievous Thrash; respect Mangling Claws.
healer: Lightfire hits three players; support with healing and defensives.
dps: Interrupt Warden's Wrath in phase one to protect the tank.
everyone: Stack Lightfire targets to dodge tornadoes easily.
Pulverizing Strikes targets spread away from others.

bosses.name: Ziekket
bosses.summary: Corrupted tree boss with permanent pulsing damage, regrowing adds and essence orbs to intercept.
tank: Defensive or bleed cleanse for Thornspike.
Keep the fight near the platform edge for beam puddles.
healer: Oozing Xylem pulses group damage all fight.
dps: Cleave Awaken The Lightbloom adds; kick Lightspore Shot.
everyone: Aim Concentrated Lightbeam over dead add bodies to remove them for good.
Soak Lightbloom's Essence orbs before they reach the boss, spreading the DoT.

dungeons.name: Altar of Fangs
dungeons.summary: New Patch 12.1 serpent-cult dungeon; rated the season's hardest, with every boss a heavy healing check.

mustKick.why: Guides say kick every cast.
Poison DoTs; kick as many as possible, dispel the rest.
CC the channel or Envenom upgrades to Mass Envenom.
Group poison; kick every cast.
Fixates randoms; not kickable, so CC and slow.

dangerousPacks: Ritual Chieftain area before the first boss: Unstable Totem pulses and Blood Sacrifice healing absorbs.
Twinfang Harrower: Paralyzing Shots on two players, heavy Duostrike, aim Toxic Breath away.
Ascendant Serpent mini-boss: spread for Infest, then group to cleave hatchlings.
Living Venom bursts on death; stagger kills so healers can recover.
Ravenous Descendant stacks an enrage; reset with soothes or CC.

bosses.name: Rav'i
bosses.summary: Scavenger hydra and a knowledge check; feeding on the wrong carrion pile wipes groups fast.
tank: Before Ssscavenging, move her to a bone pile without a Twinfang corpse.
Hydrastrike melee hits hard.
healer: Top everyone before Ravenous Stomp.
Heal through the Ssscavenging shield phase.
dps: Pool damage to break the shield quickly.
everyone: Soak Messy Eater spawns.
Spread loosely for Triple Shot; dodge Regurgitate waves.

bosses.name: The Writhing Coil
bosses.summary: Serpent swarm boss with constant poison ticking and a tether-snap phase spawning fixating snakes.
tank: Tail Scythe is not especially dangerous.
healer: Synchronized Venom ticks for most of the fight.
dps: Stack, CC and burn Uncoiled Writhes; their damage mirrors to the boss.
everyone: Kick every Toxic Atrophy cast.
Snap Death Rattle tethers instantly with movement abilities.

bosses.name: Zul'jan
bosses.summary: Ritualist finale; clear stacking venom by taking physical hits, described as incredibly difficult.
tank: Defensive for Chop Down; leftover venom stacks create puddles.
healer: Soaking all four Ritual of the Fang beams may need cooldowns.
dps: Help soak the ritual beams.
everyone: Stand in a Boneslicer to clear Ritual Venom stacks.
Dodge the three bouncing Axegrinder axes.

dungeons.name: Kings' Rest
dungeons.summary: Battle for Azeroth Zandalari royal tomb, reworked for Season 2; punishing trash and a very demanding final boss.

mustKick.why: Kick every cast; spare kicks on Shadowfrost Bolt.
Heal; kick every cast, purge if missed.
Kick every cast; spare kicks on Soul Bolt.
Kick every cast, including Mchimba's mummies.
Kick or curse-dispel every one.
Keep it interrupted during the last boss.

dangerousPacks: Minion of Zul: purge Bound By Shadow to kill it; its melee fears.
Shadow of Zul mini-boss: Shadow Barrage, two Pool of Darkness soaks, Dark Revelation targets.
King A'akul plus Bloodsworn Assassins: cleanse bleeds before Blood Drain.
Interment Construct: free Entombed players before Wail of Mourning hits.
Purification Construct: Heavy Slams plus Purification Strike strain healers.

bosses.name: The Golden Serpent
bosses.summary: Gold-spitting serpent whose puddles animate into blobs that empower it if they arrive.
tank: Tail Thrash is a minor tank hit.
healer: Use group cooldowns for the Serpentine Gust channel.
dps: Cleave Animated Gold blobs; slow and CC them.
everyone: Drop Spit Gold puddles near existing ones.

bosses.name: Mchimba the Embalmer
bosses.summary: Embalmer who entombs a player in one of four sarcophagi and spawns mummies.
tank: Pick up Half-Finished Mummies from Awakening Slam.
healer: Top Drain Fluids targets above 90% to drop the debuff.
Top everyone before Awakening Slam.
dps: Cleave mummies and kick Wretched Discharge.
everyone: Spread to find the shaking sarcophagus during Entomb.
Drop Burn Corruption fire away from boss and sarcophagi.

bosses.name: The Council of Tribes
bosses.summary: Now a fixed order: Kula the Butcher, Aka'ali the Conqueror, then Zanazal the Wise.
tank: Tank Kula centrally; her Whirling Axes keep going after death.
Kite or big defensive during Debilitating Backhand.
healer: Arc Lightning always jumps off the tank; watch group damage.
dps: Kill totems in order: Explosive, Thundering, then Torrent.
everyone: Group up to soak Barrel Through.
Interrupt Poison Nova.

bosses.name: Dazar, the First King
bosses.summary: Redesigned for Season 2; kill his raptor Reban, then he mounts T'zala at 80%.
tank: Defensive for the ramping Blade Combo after Savage Maul.
Face away from the group during Gilded Destruction.
healer: Prepare for Quaking Leap and Gilded Destruction AoE.
dps: Focus Reban first and keep Deathly Roar kicked.
everyone: Spread for Aerial Smash; avoid Hunting Leap and Impaling Spear circles.

dungeons.name: Temple of Sethraliss
dungeons.summary: Battle for Azeroth serpent-loa temple, heavily reworked; front-loaded difficulty with an easy final stretch.

mustKick.why: Random-target bolt; keep kicks on it.
Stun; now kickable in Season 2, or poison-dispel.
Random-target channel; stop with CC.
Disorients; kick or curse-dispel.
Kick rotation; also dispel Imbued Conduction before it stuns.
Channels into an Eye of Sethraliss; kick or CC.
Keep a rotation, including during the last boss.
Interrupt during the burrow add phase.

dangerousPacks: Loose Spark gauntlets: dodge spiralling orbs; kill the Spark Channeler to stop stuns.
Agitated Nimbus: purge Accumulate Charge stacks before Release Charge.
Sand-Sworn Rider summons bleeding Swarming Krolusk and fires Scouring Sand frontals.
Orb Watcher's Caustic Stomp is group damage plus DoT.

bosses.name: Adderis and Aspix
bosses.summary: Wind-and-lightning duo; immunity swaps between them at 40% health.
tank: Defensive when Adderis gains Overload.
healer: Spot-heal Gust targets.
dps: Expect more frequent abilities after Adderis dies.
everyone: Spread for Gale Force, then collapse to melee to share Thunder And Lightning.
Tempest Winds targets drop puddles away from the group.

bosses.name: Merektha
bosses.summary: Snake matriarch who burrows at full energy until her summoned vipers and serpent die.
tank: Defensive for every Lightning Bite.
Drag Storm Serpents near puddles or the edge.
healer: Prepare for Serpentstorm AoE.
Dispel Poison Spit DoTs.
dps: Kill burrow adds fast; Burrow ends when they die.
everyone: Stack in melee for Knot of Snakes so one AoE CC frees all.
Thunder Spit target drops circles at the edge.

bosses.name: Galvazzt
bosses.summary: Energy-gathering elemental; block spire beams or he hits full energy and wipes the group.
tank: Move the boss around to help soak spires; relocate off Induction puddles.
healer: Spread healing cooldowns across sustained spire damage.
dps: Non-tanks take turns intercepting Lightning Spire beams.
everyone: Never let him reach Consume Charge.

bosses.name: Avatar of Sethraliss
bosses.summary: Fully redesigned heal-the-loa encounter; Icy Veins reports it dies in about two minutes.
tank: Watch Corrupted Guardian's Tainted Strike buster.
healer: Heal the Avatar while kiting Faithless Tormentors.
dps: Kill Corrupted Guardians first, then grab Corrupted Lifeforce soaks within 6 seconds.
CC and AoE Tormentors; each heals the Avatar.
everyone: Kick Twisted Hexxer's Flame Shock; place Latent Hex puddles outside.

dungeons.name: Ruby Life Pools
dungeons.summary: Dragonflight red-dragon nursery under Primalist attack; season's shortest and easiest key, 28-minute timer per PTR notes.

mustKick.why: Shields a mob; kick or CC. Spare kicks on Frostbolt.
Random-target bolt; interrupt it.
CC-immune caster; interrupt random-target bolt.
Tank hit; spare kicks, mob is CC-immune.
Tank hit; spare kicks.
Channel into the tank; stop with CC.

dangerousPacks: Mini-boss before Melidrussa is the dungeon's main speed bump per Icy Veins.
Blazebound Destroyer: Inferno party DoT and Burnout explosion on death; leave its range.
Flamegullet gains Molten Blood at 50%; plan cooldowns.
Thunderhead's Rolling Thunder: stagger dispels to avoid stacked group DoTs.
Two lieutenants in Kokia's area are best skipped.

bosses.name: Melidrussa Chillworn
bosses.summary: Frost Primalist who shields herself and summons whelps at 66% and 33%.
tank: Pick up Infused Whelps; dispel or freedom Cold Claws before 20 stacks.
healer: Chillstorm target needs heals while resisting the pull.
dps: Save burst to break Ice Bulwark and end Frost Overload.
everyone: Kick Frigid Shard.
Group to bait Hailburst, then rotate around the room.

bosses.name: Kokia Blazehoof
bosses.summary: Fire Primalist binding players to spawn Blazebound Firestorm adds.
tank: Defensive for every Searing Blows.
healer: Heal through the add's Inferno.
dps: Focus the Blazebound Firestorm add.
Kick Blaze Volley.
everyone: Ritual Of Blazebinding target moves somewhere open.
Bait Molten Boulders off your path.

bosses.name: Kyrakka and Erkhart Stormvein
bosses.summary: Drake and rider; rotating winds push fire puddles, and Erkhart mounts up at 50%.
tank: Get Stormslam's magic debuff dispelled before the next cast.
healer: Dispel Stormslam; pool cooldowns for the mounted phase.
dps: Stop casting when Interrupting Cloudburst begins.
everyone: Inferno Spit targets drop fire away, accounting for the next Winds Of Change direction.
Dodge Roaring Firebreath.

unverified: Voidscar Arena screamer spelling conflicts: Method says Killvore Screamer / Mass Shriek, Icy Veins says Kilivore Screamer / Mad Shriek.

wow.gg uses different boss names (Taz'ra, Atrox, Charon, Kistia Mana-Heart, Zaen Mournblade, Zatuuks, Lithiel Ashen Fury); Method and Icy Veins agree on the names used here, so wow.gg was not relied on for names.
Method's Nalorakk section mentions Zul'jarra; Icy Veins confirms Zul'jarra is not a boss, only a location to protect.
PTR tuning notes (July 7/21) may differ from live: Ruby Life Pools 28-minute timer, Temple Galvanize/Galvanized changes.
Altar of Fangs Death Rattle: Method says snap tethers; wow.gg says interrupt using Orveina's Vine Grip buff. Not reconciled.
No source gave dungeon-specific affix tips for this season.
Kyrakka's partner is spelled Erkhart in Method, Erkheart in one Icy Veins post.
